member.name: T:Program
member.remarks:
This is the launcher for Tekst engine games, and it only does a few basic things:
1. Validates the command-line arguments.
2. Loads the game cartridge.
3. Displays the opening credits.
4. Starts the main game loop.
5. Displays the closing credits.

member.name: M:Program.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Main method where the execution starts.

member.name: M:Program.Launch(System.String)
member.summary: Launches the game by loading the cartridge, displaying the opening credits, and starting the main game loop.
member.param: The name of the game to launch.
